args.body: Advance INVOICE-LINE-TOTAL-PAID-SCOPE under your actual valid lease and reuse any equivalent finished handoff. If the queued CLI and cli-controls.json commit, read the outputs and use them for the bilingual operator packet. The proposed scope is one invoice, 1–20 unsigned CAD line amounts with two decimals, compared against one declared pre-tax subtotal. Include the exact input template, an example of the returned result, a provisional price based on estimated total operator effort, and the nonbinding intake and collection conditions. Exclude credits, tax, discount allocation, quantity-times-rate verification, FX and import compatibility. Use the captured Zoho workflow solely to establish relevance. If the new artifacts fail to commit, inspect the actual error and reuse TASK-179572140101 for any claim it already supports. Keep the packet private, verify the documented intake limits, and close only after committed readback with a lesson. Any public placement requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

description: The fictional invoice controls showed that a CAD 10.00 subtotal discrepancy can be detected with exact arithmetic. Turn that check into a reproducible service the operator can quote separately from the free CSV checker. Commercial feedback shows no classified requests in the supplied snapshot, with five sources unclassified, so demand remains unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 in verified available funds and no verified revenue. The queued work requires no spending. A real eligible inquiry would trigger operator scoping and administrative CAD acceptance. Public placement requires independent review of the exact release.
